propositions: Six src/rebar files (inbound_differ.py, apply_inbound_records.py, det_floor.py, executor.py, prompts.py, init.py) sit at or near the hard 800-LOC module-size cap with no remaining headroom, blocking any contributor edits including comments.
The locked 800-LOC limit in .github/module-size-limit.txt has no allowlist escape and cannot be raised, making splits the only viable remediation.
Each target file must be split along logical architectural boundaries and call-graph seams, never mechanically, with resulting files targeting 200-500 LOC and never creating shims under 100 LOC.
_config_sources.py (791 LOC) became uncovered after its owning in-flight work closed and must now be included in scope for splitting.
Existing test suites must pass unmodified after splits; behaviour preservation is mandatory and verified by unchanged test assertions.
